rows.vgi.doc_md:
# supported_encodings

The discovery table of every encoding label the worker accepts. One row per encoding, with a single `label` column (e.g. `UTF-8`, `windows-1252`, `Shift_JIS`). Use it to find valid encoding inputs for `to_utf8_from` and `transcode`.
rows.vgi.title: Supported Encodings Catalog

rows: CREATE TABLE supported_encodings("label" VARCHAR, UNIQUE("label"), PRIMARY KEY("label"));
